# Bheema's Indian Cuisine & Spirits

> Bheema's Indian Cuisine & Spirits, located at 6659 Western Row Rd, Mason, OH 45040, offers a wide range of traditional Indian dishes including curries, tandoori specialties, biryanis, and various vegetarian and vegan options. The restaurant is known for its lunch buffet and features bold spices and real recipes.

## Menu
Offers a wide range of traditional Indian dishes including curries, tandoori specialties, biryanis, and various vegetarian and vegan options. Known for its lunch buffet.
